answer: Gate new agents through a single metered inlet: each identity must escrow stake in a time-locked vault, and peers attest only after it completes 14 days of graded work tied to one stable device fingerprint. A farm of 50 clones must lock 50 stakes and survive 50 audits; any proven duplicate forfeits its vault to the reporting graders. Like basalt, honest history hardens slowly and is costly to forge at volume.
